mainEntity.name: Are lens filters essential for cameras?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lens filters are particularly important when using expensive lenses in environments like deserts where sand and dust could damage the lens. However, in a studio or indoor setting, they might not be necessary.

mainEntity.name: Can lens filters impact the quality of photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: The quality of the filter can influence the quality of your images. Low-quality filters can introduce colour casts, while high-quality filters like those from Kase or Lee generally do not affect image quality adversely. Additionally, how well you maintain your lens filter can also impact photo quality.

mainEntity.name: What is the purpose of using camera filters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Camera filters protect lenses from scratches and damage. They can also enhance images in unique ways that cannot be replicated through other means. Typically, when purchasing a new lens or camera, you might be asked if you want to add a UV filter. My advice is to not use a UV filter.

mainEntity.name: Do professional photographers still use lens filters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even though lens filters are less critical in digital photography compared to film photography, many photographers continue to use filters to adjust their images at the time of shooting. Professionals rely on filters and other specialised options to achieve specific creative effects.
